evidence.observation: The task names the B200 GEMV operation and uses max(FFMA, DRAM). An 8-TB/s payload calculation matched all three published rows within five percent, while a deliberately broken 16-TB/s control differed by more than 45 percent.

challenge.outcome: The DRAM model reproduces the rows closely, while neither source supports extrapolation to every implementation.

claims.claim: PTX ISA 9.0 defines the displayed packed E2M1 conversion, typed b32-to-four-byte move, and v2/v4 u64 load widths; Yue used the conversion/move in an author-reported path, while the ISA makes no universal performance promise.
